title: Single-participant vertical-force anticipation
independent_unit: Entire speed run within one participant; only two development runs and one faster reserved run
scope: One participant, three treadmill speeds; no independent-person generalization. Force-platform channels are signed and the source timing columns are unusable.
timing: Causal10ms block means sampled100Hz from source1000Hz sequence. At block end t, predict the10ms block ending t+100ms. Every feature uses blocks ending at or before t.
calibration: No target calibration from held run; preceding five seconds of its force waveform supply causal period and history. Known treadmill speed is permitted.
